exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–60 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
Alluvium was not converted into an exact lead because its strongest structural evidence is album-level. Kinesia's documented 5/4 opening belongs to Miso feat. machìna and was not attributed to Perma.

No lead was promoted for recency, geography, artist reputation, label reputation, genre, novelty or structural cleverness. BPM, energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown unless explicitly stated.
